items.exampleEn: I bought a gift for my mother.
items.exampleZh: 我買了一份禮物給我媽媽。

items.exampleEn: Our neighbor has a big dog.
items.exampleZh: 我們的鄰居有一隻大狗。

items.exampleEn: My dad takes me to school every day.
We celebrate my birthday at home.
items.exampleZh: 我們在家慶祝我的生日。

items.exampleEn: She gives her baby a kiss.
My grandmother is seventy years old.
My cousin and I are the same age.

items.audioEn: My cousin is coming tonight. We will celebrate her birthday.
items.audioZh: 我表姊今晚要來，我們要幫她慶生。
items.questionZh: 他們今晚要慶祝誰的生日？

items.sentenceEn: She kisses her baby good night.

items.stemEn: We ____ the New Year with our family.
items.stemZh: 我們和家人一起慶祝新年。

items.stemEn: Mr. Lee lives in the house near ours. He is our ____.
items.stemZh: 李先生住在我們家附近，他是我們的鄰居。

items.passageEn: Today is my grandmother's birthday. She is seventy. My mom and dad cook a big dinner, and my cousins come too. Our neighbor, Mrs. Chen, brings flowers. We give Grandma our gifts, and she gives each of us a kiss. We celebrate until late.
items.passageZh: 今天是我奶奶的生日，她七十歲了。我爸媽煮了一頓豐盛的晚餐，我的堂兄弟姊妹也來了。我們的鄰居陳太太帶了花來。我們把禮物送給奶奶，她親了我們每個人一下。我們一直慶祝到很晚。

items.promptZh: 我們在家慶祝爸爸的生日。
referenceEn: We celebrate Dad's birthday at home.
We celebrate my dad's birthday at home.
rubricZh: celebrate 後面直接接要慶祝的事（例如 celebrate Dad's birthday）
「爸爸的」可寫 Dad's、my dad's、my father's 等

items.promptZh: 我的鄰居每天早上跑步。
referenceEn: My neighbor goes running every morning.
rubricZh: 動詞配合主詞（例如 runs、goes running）；英式拼法 neighbour 也正確
「每天早上」可寫，例如 every morning 等
